name: improved divine smite
desc: By 11th level, you are so suffused with righteous might that all your melee weapon strikes carry divine power with them.

Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the creature takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage. If you also use your @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.classfeatures.Item.ySMPQ6zNSlvkrl2f]{Divine Smite} with an attack, you add this damage to the extra damage of your Divine Smite.
